title: GOOD NIGHT OUT
tickerText:
Good Night Out is a high-energy band formed in 2016, bringing together five seasoned musicians with a shared passion for delivering unforgettable live music experiences. With decades of combined experience performing across Australia and New Zealand, we know how to get the crowd moving and keep the dance floor alive from the first note to the final encore.

With the tight rhythm and musical talents of Rich, Pete, Craig, Siggy, and Rob, we cover the songs you know and love – from classic rock anthems and 80s hits to modern favourites that keep every crowd singing along.

Whether it’s a pub gig, private party, corporate event, or festival, we bring the perfect mix of energy, musicianship, and fun to every show. Our goal is simple – to make sure you and your guests have a Good Night Out every single time.
